name: Kaas v1.0.9
body:
# Changes

1. Added French
2. Added support for Deepseek, xAI (Grok) and Google (Gemini)

name: Kaas v1.0.8
body:
# Changes

1. Added support for reasoning models (mainly DeepSeek R1 through Ollama or OpenRouter)

name: Kaas v1.0.7
body:
# Changes

1. Upgraded Tauri to v2
2. Fixed some minor bugs

name: Kaas v1.0.6
body:
# Changes

1. Fixed a bug where some settings are reset after adding/editing models
2. The "pinned" status of the side bar is now remebered after closing the app
3. Added a button to copy code blocks in bot's messages
4. You can know adjust the layout of the chat section, two widths are available now: 640px and 800 px

name: Kaas v1.0.5
body:
# Changes

1. You can now pin and lock the left navigation bar from being retracted
2. You can now browse and choose images to upload in addition to Drag & Drop
3. Fixed the bug that some settings are not immediately updated after save

name: Kaas v1.0.4
body:
# Changes

1. Prompt templates can now be duplicated
2. Images in a conversation can now be viewed in a carousel and saved to disk
3. Fixed table styles in a message
4. Fixed styles when using a prompt template
5. Changed the max value of max_tokens

name: Kaas v1.0.3
body:
# Changes

1. Added support of OpenRouter and all its models
2. Added auto update
3. Added context menu to inputs/textareas so you can do usual text operations with mouse clicks now
4. Some minor UIUE improvements

name: Kaas v1.0.2
body:
# Changes

1. Made layout responsive
2. Some minor UIUE improvements & fixes

name: Kaas v1.0.1
body:
# Changes

1. Added support of Ollama models
2. Added support of OpenAI Compatible models
3. Fixed the bug with editing Claude models
4. Refactored the UIUE of adding new models
